summary: The proof is complete and correct. The normalization preserves all relevant area and payment ratios, the residual domain supplies the two strict area inequalities used, and the clipping-cell analysis covers all signs and full/nonfull q-cap cases. The midpoint containment gives the stated support bounds, the two-direction clamp lemma is proved on every zero, quadratic, saturated, and equality branch, and its application through the bounding-rectangle width products is valid. The final strict inequality follows from the tail-derived bound alpha<1/3 and the strict residual inequality M-m<1/2. Support-contact and clamp boundaries remain covered, and the rational sequence satisfies every stated strict hypothesis while proving the claimed normalized infimum.
